manual.title: Add ASIC Miner
manual.description: Enter the IP address of your ASIC miner.

scan.title: Scan Network
scan.description: Enter the subnet to scan. This has been pre-filled from your network settings.

scanning.title: Scanning…
scanning.description: Scanning {subnet} for ASIC miners. This may take up to 30 seconds.

pick_miner.title: Select Miner
pick_miner.description: Choose a miner from the list of devices found on your network.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Enter login credentials for {host}, or leave blank if authentication is not required.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address and that the miner is online.
error.no_miners_found: No miners were found on that subnet. Try a different range.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: Miner Options
init.description: Set the firmware web password (VNish: needed for preset/throttle control). Leave blank if not required.
